summary: ansible-core unit tests live in test/units, mirroring the lib/ansible directory layout.
questions: How are Ansible unit test files organized?

answer_card.title: Where unit tests live
answer_card.answer_md: Unit tests are in [`test/units`](https://github.com/ansible/ansible/tree/devel/test/units). The layout mirrors `lib/ansible/`, so the test for a file sits at the matching path.
